title: Register, log in, and access authenticated features
description: A new patient can register, log in, and reach authenticated functionality after receiving a session token.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the registration details for a new patient with a unique email and valid password
Submit the registration form
Fill in the login credentials for the newly registered patient
Submit the login form
Verify the user is signed in and authenticated features are available

title: Book an appointment and see it in the appointment list
description: An authenticated patient can book an appointment and confirm it appears in their personal appointment list.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login credentials for a valid patient account
Submit the login form
Open the appointment booking flow
Fill in valid appointment details
Submit the appointment form
Open the appointment list for the current patient
Verify the newly booked appointment is displayed in the patient appointment list

title: Cancel an appointment and confirm it is removed from the list
description: An authenticated patient can cancel an existing appointment and no longer see it in their updated appointment list.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login credentials for a valid patient account
Submit the login form
Open the appointment list for the current patient
Select an existing appointment to cancel
Confirm the cancellation
Refresh the appointment list view
Verify the canceled appointment is no longer displayed

title: Browse verified doctors as a guest
description: A guest can open the public doctor directory and see verified doctors listed for discovery.

steps.description: Navigate to the doctor directory page
Verify verified doctors are displayed
Verify at least one doctor profile is visible

title: See doctor details needed before booking
description: A guest can inspect the public doctor directory content needed to decide whether to book an appointment.

steps.description: Navigate to the doctor directory page
Verify doctor profiles are displayed
Verify doctor specialization or qualification information is visible

title: Open the doctor directory from the app entry point
description: A guest can reach the verified doctor listing from the main browsing experience without signing in.

steps.description: Navigate to the app entry point
Click the link to view verified doctors
Verify verified doctors are displayed

title: Upload a medical document and see it in health records
description: An authenticated patient can upload a valid medical document and then retrieve it from their health record list.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login credentials for a valid patient account
Submit the login form
Open the medical record upload flow
Provide a valid medical document
Submit the record upload form
Open the current patient's health record list
Verify the uploaded health record is displayed in the record list

title: Browse verified doctors before booking
description: A guest can open the verified doctor directory and see available doctor listings for discovery.

steps.description: Navigate to the verified doctor directory
Verify verified doctor listings are displayed

title: Register with an existing email and then log in
description: A patient can see that duplicate registration is rejected and still log in with the existing account.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the registration details for a patient with a unique email and valid password
Submit the registration form
Fill in the registration details again using the same email and a valid password
Submit the registration form
Fill in the login credentials for that email and password
Submit the login form
Verify a duplicate registration error is shown and the user can still sign in

title: Switch from doctor discovery to booking preparation
description: A guest can use the public doctor directory as the starting point for a later appointment booking journey.

steps.description: Navigate to the doctor directory page
Verify verified doctors are displayed
Verify the directory supports selecting a doctor for next-step booking

title: View a specific patient's health records for review
description: An authenticated patient or care provider can open a specific patient record list and see the returned health records.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login credentials for a valid patient or care provider account
Submit the login form
Open the health records search or review view
Select a specific patient
Verify that the selected patient's health records are displayed

title: Reject invalid login credentials
description: A visitor entering incorrect credentials sees a login validation error and remains signed out.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login credentials with an unregistered email and password
Submit the login form
Verify an invalid credentials error is shown

title: Handle an invalid appointment cancellation
description: A patient attempting to cancel a non-existent appointment sees an error state and no cancellation confirmation.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login credentials for a valid patient account
Submit the login form
Open the appointment cancellation flow for an invalid or non-existent appointment reference
Confirm the cancellation
Verify a cancellation error is shown

title: See an empty doctor directory state
description: If no verified doctors are available, the public directory shows an empty-state message instead of a misleading list.

steps.description: Navigate to the doctor directory page
Verify an empty state message is visible
Verify no doctor profiles are displayed

title: Reject an unsupported medical file upload
description: An authenticated patient who selects an invalid medical file payload sees upload validation feedback and no upload confirmation.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login credentials for a valid patient account
Submit the login form
Open the medical record upload flow
Provide an unsupported or invalid medical file payload
Submit the record upload form
Verify an upload validation error is shown

title: See doctor discovery when the list cannot be shown
description: If the directory cannot be rendered, the public browsing experience does not show a doctor list.

steps.description: Navigate to the doctor directory page
Verify the doctor list is not displayed
Verify a loading or unavailable state is visible
